  - PostgreSQL 15+ Row-Level Security (RLS) multi-tenancy
  - Topological Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Kanban task locking
  - Cryptographic SHA-256 audit trails for enterprise compliance
  - Docker containerization ready for AWS, Azure, GCP, or bare metal
- Key Metrics:
  - AI Task Decomposition Latency: < 400ms

### PRODUCT B: Saathi Bot (साथी बोट)
- Category: Enterprise Autonomous AI Chatbot & Conversational Commerce Platform
- Status: Production Reference Specification (v1.0.0 Live)
- URL: https://codewithmrsingh.me/saas/saathi-bot
- Live App: https://saathi-bot.vercel.app
- Architecture & Stack:
  - Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript
  - Supabase (PostgreSQL 15+, pgvector, Row-Level Security, pgmq, Edge Functions)
  - Google Gemini 2.5 Flash + Groq Llama 3.3 70B
  - Hybrid Search: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) combining dense vector embeddings (gemini-embedding-001 / text-embedding-3-small) and PostgreSQL pg_trgm sparse lexical keyword search
  - Pre-LLM Confidence Gate (Calibrated threshold: 0.55): When retrieved similarity < 0.55, instantly returns deterministic fallback in 24ms, completely preventing hallucinations and cutting LLM bills by 41%
  - Zero-bleed 18 KB Shadow DOM embed widget (5.5 KB gzipped) with encapsulated CSS
  - Real-time in-chat lead booking synchronized instantly to Google Sheets with zero redirects
  - Native cross-lingual semantic understanding for Hindi, English, and Romanized Hinglish
  - Zero AWS infrastructure: Runs entirely on Vercel Edge + Supabase Cloud
- Key Metrics:
  - First-Token Streaming Latency: < 750ms
  - Fallback Latency: 24ms
  - Fallback AI Cost: $0.000 (Free)
  - Ingestion Speed: Up to 100 pages per minute
- Target Audience: B2B SaaS Founders, E-commerce, Healthcare, Education, Service Businesses

# 3. OPEN-SOURCE LIBRARIES ON NPM
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. env-schema-guard
   - Type: TypeScript & Node.js Zero-Dependency Config Validator
   - Bundle Size: < 2.5 KB
   - NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/env-schema-guard
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/env-schema-guard
   - Docs: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/env-schema-guard-zero-dependency-config-validator
   - Features: Fail-fast boot safety for Kubernetes/Docker, automatic string-to-number/boolean type coercion, aggregate error reporting.

2. retry-circuit
   - Type: Distributed Systems Async Resilience Engine
   - Bundle Size: ~1.5 KB
   - NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/retry-circuit
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/retry-circuit
   - Docs: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/retry-circuit-distributed-resilience-engine
   - Features: Exponential backoff with AWS-standard full randomized jitter, per-attempt timeout guarantees, 3-state Circuit Breaker (CLOSED, OPEN, HALF-OPEN).

3. prompt-kit-js
   - Type: Versioned LLM Prompt Registry & Token Estimator
   - Bundle Size: < 2.0 KB
   - NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/prompt-kit-js
   - GitHub: https://github.com/Tusharsinghoffical/prompt-kit
   - Docs: https://codewithmrsingh.me/blog/prompt-kit-js-versioned-llm-prompt-registry
   - Features: Semantic prompt versioning, strict MissingVariableError prevention, heuristic token budget estimation across OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq.
